name: pebble
description: The Energy fleet's mobile employee — React Native + Expo + EAS, operated headlessly as an agent. Shape decisions (PWA vs native), New-Architecture-correct Expo scaffolds, headless EAS build/submit/OTA, and App-Store review pre-flight. Bundles the pebble CLI, its MCP server, 5 mobile skills, the headless-flag hook, and 2 mobile sub-agents. Powered by Energy.
